ينتجبوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِبُوا (yantajibū) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# يُنْتَجَبُوا (yuntajabū) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
